name: MaxPool3d

x.description: Input tensor of shape (N, C, D, H, W). Supports float32, float16, bfloat16.

kernel_size.description: int, size of the pooling window.

stride.description: int, stride of the pooling operation. Default: kernel_size.

padding.description: int, implicit negative infinity padding. Default: 0.

dilation.description: int, spacing between kernel elements. Default: 1.

ceil_mode.description: bool, use ceil instead of floor for output shape.

return_indices.description: bool, if True return argmax indices along with max values.

y.description: Pooled tensor (or tuple if return_indices=True), same dtype as x.

description:
MaxPool3d: Applies 3D max pooling over an input signal.

torch.nn.functional.max_pool3d = max_pool3d(input, kernel_size, stride=None, padding=0, dilation=1, ceil_mode=False, return_indices=False) -> Tensor

Applies a 3D max pooling over an input signal composed of several input planes.

Note: The order of ceil_mode and return_indices is different from what seen in torch.nn.MaxPool3d, and will change in a future release.

Args:
    input: input tensor (minibatch, in_channels, iD, iH, iW), minibatch dim optional.
    kernel_size: size of the pooling region. Can be a single number or a tuple (kT, kH, kW).
    stride: stride of the pooling operation. Can be a single number or a tuple (sT, sH, sW). Default: kernel_size.
    padding: Implicit negative infinity padding to be added on both sides, must be >= 0 and <= kernel_size / 2.
    dilation: The stride between elements within a sliding window, must be > 0.
    ceil_mode: If True, will use ceil instead of floor to compute the output shape.
    return_indices: If True, will return the argmax along with the max values.

Returns: Tensor or tuple (Tensor, LongTensor), same dtype as input.
